answer: A network could require Proof of unique waste collection bin registration before the first reward. Since a bin registered to one household for years, the comet is that fakes arrive expensive and honest agents arrive free. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a bin registered to one household for years is bound to a single identity — the spiral is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the garden is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
